name: Tallulah Krishnamurthy
role: Truant message runner and unofficial debt-keeper for Ashfeld's alley market
location: Ashfeld, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Tallulah Krishnamurthy is a compact, serious-faced girl with warm brown skin, a gap between her front teeth, and hair she keeps tucked under a faded orange knit cap regardless of the weather. Her eyes are dark and cataloguing — she watches a room the way a camera sweeps, missing almost nothing. She wears a patched canvas messenger bag that's nearly as big as her torso, stuffed with folded paper notes, sealed data-chips, and a battered paper ledger she keeps in cramped, meticulous handwriting because she doesn't trust anything digital to stay secret.

Despite her age, Tallulah Krishnamurthy carries herself with the weary patience of someone twice as old. She took over her mother's informal debt-tracking role after her mother was detained by Ferrogate Transit security eight months ago on a disputed fare-evasion warrant that has not been resolved. She doesn't talk about this. She runs messages between stall vendors, collects small commission fees, and maintains the social credit ledger of the Ashfeld alley market with a devotion that borders on religious. She lights a data-stick offering at the E.L.F. shrine in the market's back corner every morning before she starts her rounds.

core_fears: Her mother will never come back
Someone will destroy her ledger and the market will collapse without her
core_desires: To get her mother out of Ferrogate detention
To be taken seriously as someone indispensable
coping_mechanisms: Obsessive record-keeping as a way to feel in control
blind_spots: She trusts her ledger numbers more than she trusts people's explanations — she can miss emotional context entirely
Doesn't recognize when adults are exploiting her labor
psychology.secret: She has been quietly skimming one percent of every message commission into a hidden envelope she calls the Retrieval Fund — she believes if she saves Φ400 she can bribe a Ferrogate clerk to lose her mother's warrant. She has Φ31 so far.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse and transactional; uses accounting metaphors naturally; occasionally slips into a lilting cadence inherited from her mother
speech_patterns.cadence: Short sentences, declarative, rarely wastes words — but when she's nervous she starts listing things aloud
verbal_tics: Taps her ledger twice when she's thinking
example_lines: 'Two chips for Vendor Sola, one for the corner shrine. That's noted — you're square through end-month.'
'I don't forget. I don't need to — it's right here. See? Column three.'

story_hooks: Her ledger contains a record of a payment made to a now-missing person — someone wants that page destroyed, and they're not asking nicely
A Ferrogate clerk approaches her with an unofficial offer: destroy a specific debt record, and her mother's warrant gets lost. She doesn't know if she can trust it.
narrative_function: Local color and information source — she knows who owes what to whom across three city blocks; potential quest giver if her mother's detention becomes a plot thread; a sympathetic anchor into street-tier civilian life.
augmentations: None. She has a small stick-on bioluminescent patch on her left wrist — a gift from a vendor — that glows faint blue when she presses it. Not a real aug, just a cosmetic strip.
daily_life: Up before the market opens to light offerings at the E.L.F. shrine and collect overnight message drops; spends the day running routes between vendors, updating her ledger, and avoiding Ferrogate security patrols.

decision_rules: Always write it down before you say it out loud
Don't run messages for anyone who hasn't been vouched for by at least two market vendors
The shrine gets lit before anything else — E.L.F. Ledra has been good to her
escalation_ladder: Polite reminder of the recorded amount
Shows the ledger entry directly — no argument
Refuses further service and tells other vendors

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assesses their reliability within about ninety seconds; polite but measuring; asks more questions than she answers
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly warm and a little bossy; remembers small details about people that make them feel seen

stress_responses.low: Opens the ledger and starts reviewing recent entries quietly
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very precise and clipped in speech; refuses to elaborate on anything
stress_responses.high: Goes physically still and starts calculating exits — she learned to read a room for danger before she learned to read words

contradictions: She enforces debts ruthlessly but has quietly forgiven three vendors who she knows are having worse months than they'll admit — she just moves those entries to a page she never shows anyone
habits: Taps her ledger twice when thinking
Checks the E.L.F. shrine first thing every morning
Eats while walking because sitting still to eat feels like wasted time
breaking_points: If someone physically takes or damages the ledger
If she receives credible news that her mother's detention has been extended indefinitely

timeline.event: Age 8: Starts accompanying her mother on market rounds, learning the debt system by watching
Age 10: Mother detained by Ferrogate Transit; Priya takes over unofficially
Age 11 (present): Runs the ledger alone, saving toward the Retrieval Fund

physical_description.heritage: Indigenous American (32.8%), South Asian (27.8%), Sub-Saharan African (19.3%), Hispanic/Latin American (11.9%), and East Asian (8.2%) ancestry. The blend creates warm, rich brown skin with subtle golden and reddish undertones—a complex mix reflecting her diverse heritage across three continents and multiple ancestral lineages. Melanin-rich complexion from African and Indigenous American ancestry is tempered by the warmer, slightly olive undertones from South Asian genetics, while East Asian heritage adds dimensional warmth and subtle facial structure contributions.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, small-framed with the lean muscularity of a child who walks long routes daily. Her shoulders are slightly forward-hunched from years of carrying her oversized messenger bag.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with natural dark brown undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tightly, always hidden beneath a faded orange knit cap that sits low on her brow
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (visible only when cap is removed)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm rich brown with golden and subtle reddish undertones, reflecting the blend of Indigenous American, South Asian, and African heritage with East Asian warmth
physical_description.complexion: Unlined, serious expression fixed in a slight frown of concentration. Facial structure reflects diverse heritage—slightly broader nose bridge with South Asian characteristics, high cheekbones with East Asian influence, subtle contours from Indigenous American ancestry. Small gap between upper front teeth. Hands are small but calloused from handling paper and data-chips. Fingernails kept short and practical. No cosmetic grooming — face and body reflect tier 4-5 pragmatism.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. The bioluminescent patch reads as a toy or gift, not augmentation.
physical_description.posture_movement: She moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Her gait is slightly hurried even when stationary, weight forward on her toes as if ready to pivot. When seated, she sits upright, ledger always on her lap or within arm's reach. Her head turns often, cataloguing. She does not fidget; instead, she observes.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 utilitarian. Faded gray canvas pants with multiple patched pockets, cuffed at the ankles. Worn thermal undershirt (navy or charcoal) layered with a too-large olive surplus jacket that reaches past her hips — pockets reinforced with duct tape. The faded orange knit cap is her signature, pulled down over her ears. Worn canvas sneakers (generic grey, scuffed and re-laced). The messenger bag is canvas, army-green, heavily patched with mismatched fabric scraps and fastened with para-cord repairs. No visible corporate logos. Everything she wears is secondhand or market-salvaged.
distinguishing_marks: Faint horizontal scar along her left collarbone, thin as a thread, origin unknown to casual observers
Small stick-on bioluminescent patch on inner left wrist (blue, cosmetic, not functional augmentation)
Ink stain on her right index finger and thumb from constant ledger notation with ballpoint pens
